name: Riada

attributes.attribute: son of a king of Munster
led his people away from famine

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Riada is an Irish hero who was born to a Munster king. A famine drove him to lead his people away. He set down first in County Antrim, which lies in Ulster. He then crossed the Irish Sea to Scotland by boat. The two lands he founded both carried the name Dal Riada.

okr.objective: Riada is an Irish hero who led his people to new land.
key_results: Riada is the son of a king of Munster.
He led his people away from a famine.
He settled first in County Antrim.
Both kingdoms he founded bore the name Dál Riada.
